**Flyer Text – “Help Save Lina’s Smile”**  

---

### Headline  
**Help Save Lina’s Smile**  

### Body  

Every single euro you give goes straight to the children waiting for medical care on the other side of the world.  

While we keep overheads at a minimum, about **40 %** of each donation covers the costs of our community events and a small salary for our volunteer staff—so that we can keep our community outreach alive and our team motivated. That leaves **60 %** of the money to be directed solely at **direct medical support**, treatment, and supplies for the children we serve.  

**Why it matters:** You’re not just giving money—you’re becoming part of a child’s story, turning pain into hope, and helping that child feel a little bit closer to a bright future.  

---

### Emotional Story  

**Lina** – a 7‑year‑old girl from a small village in Nepal who’s been fighting a rare disease that leaves her with limited mobility and daily pain. Though her days are often spent on a hospital bed, she still holds onto a single, vivid dream: one day she will run along the beach, feeling the cool sand beneath her feet and the warm sun on her face.

---

### Suggestion for the Photo  

Imagine a gentle photograph of **Lina** sitting beside a hospital window, a soft smile on her face as she clutches a well‑worn stuffed animal.  

*Caption (to place under or beside the photo):*  

> **Lina’s Story – Helping her dream come true**  

---

### Footer (optional)  

Together, we can give Lina—and the many children like her—the chance to heal, play, and smile again.  

*Donations can be made online or by mail (please see our website for details).*  

---

Feel free to replace “Lina” with any fictional child’s name you prefer, and adapt the photo description to fit the visual you intend to use. The emotional connection will inspire generosity, and the transparency about the 40 % overhead costs keeps the message honest and trustworthy.
